**On the geometry of two state models for the colored Jones polynomial**

*September 16, 2022*

66 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** Using the ﬂow property of the R-matrix deﬁning the colored Jones polynomial, we establish a natural bijection between the set of states on the part arc-graph of a link projection and the set of states on a corresponding bichromatic digraph, called arc-graph, as deﬁned by Garoufalidis and Loebl [7]. We use this to give a new and essentially elementary proof for the knot state-sum formula in [7]. We will show that the state-sum contributions of states on the part arc-graph de- ﬁned by the universal R-matrix of Uq(sl(2, C)) correspond, under our bijection of sets of states, to the contributions in [7]. This will show that the two state models are in fact not essentially distinct. Our ap- proach will also extend the formula of Garoufalidis and Loebl to links. This requires some additional non-trivial observations concerning the geometry of states on the part arc-graphs.
